messages.content: Write an announcement telling customers that a service is moving to a new platform next quarter. Around 250 words.

output:
Assumed placeholders for the details you didn't specify — swap the bracketed bits.

---

**Subject: [Service] moves to [New Platform] on [15 January]**

Hi [name],

We're moving [Service] onto [New Platform] next quarter. The cutover is [15 January].

Your account comes with you. Data, saved settings, billing history, API keys — all of it migrates automatically, and you don't need to export or re-upload anything. Same login, same password. From [15 January] you'll sign in at [new.example.com]; the old address will redirect for six months.

What actually changes: the dashboard is laid out differently, reports run in about a quarter of the time they do now, and scheduled exports move from hourly to every fifteen minutes. Two things go away. The legacy CSV importer is retired, replaced by the bulk upload tool, and the v1 API stops accepting writes on [1 March]. If you're on v1, our team will contact you directly this month with a migration guide.

Expect roughly two hours of downtime on cutover day, starting 02:00 UTC. We picked that window because it's the quietest hour across our customer base. Nothing queued during the outage is lost; jobs resume when the platform comes back.

You don't have to do anything before then. If you'd like a walkthrough of the new dashboard first, we're running short sessions every Thursday in December — [link to book].

Questions go to [support@example.com], or reply to this email and it lands with the same team.

Thanks for sticking with us through this one.

[Name]
[Title], [Company]

---

~250 words. Tell me the real service, platform, and dates and I'll fill it in.
